# AMCOL Haulage & Logistics

AMCOL Haulage & Logistics provides nation wide transport, stand-by truck and trailer service, heavy haulage cargo, oversized cargo moves, heavy lifting services, and hazardous, flammable and explosive cargo transport in Trinidad and Tobago.
